Add as many searches as needed. Words within each search narrow that group (e.g. cortex L5). Leave the search blank to show all cell populations. Empty additional searches are ignored. Matching populations appear once, in the first matching group.
Tick multiple genes to compare their expression.
Rank by mean expression
Means use only the genes and cell populations currently displayed. Untick to restore the original order.
No matching cell populations or genes. Try a broader search or select more genes.
Expression0

Use the horizontal slider or Left/Right buttons to navigate wide heatmaps without browser back gestures. Hover or tap a heatmap tile for expression and original cell annotations. Ranking uses arithmetic means of the displayed expression measurements, not statistical enrichment. When comparing multiple searches, the groups are separated by lines. Fixed colour scaling is recommended for direct comparisons.
